title: Terminal: First Steps
summary: Set up the first safe Terminal loop before widening the route.

blocks.title: Start Small
blocks.body: Open the terminal, check available tabs, and learn which systems publish records or recipes into it. Keep one terminal near your main staging area.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: A first terminal setup puts one console near staging, opens each available tab, and learns which systems publish records into the operations view.

blocks.title: Before You Expand
blocks.body: Name the goal, the exit, and the resource or signal that proves Terminal is helping. If any of those are vague, keep the next run shorter.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
